Moderator: Thanks for joining. To start, can you tell me about how you currently handle expense reports?
P03: Sure. So I've been at the company about eight years now, and honestly the process hasn't changed much. I take photos of receipts, then at the end of the month I sit down and do them all at once.
Moderator: All at once?
P03: Yeah. I know you're supposed to do them as you go. I guess it's fine, but honestly I usually just don't bother with it until I have to.
Moderator: What makes you wait?
P03: It's not the most obvious thing in the world, the submit screen. I'm never really sure if it saved. So I end up doing three or four and then checking, and doing three or four more and then checking.
Moderator: Tell me more about that checking.
P03: I click back to the list to see if they're there. Sometimes they are, sometimes they're not, and I can't tell you why.
Moderator: Has anything gone wrong?
P03: Once I lost a whole batch. Twelve receipts. I had to redo them from the photos.
Moderator: How did that feel?
P03: Pretty annoying. But I mean, it's fine now, I've got my system.
Moderator: Would you say the tool works well for you?
P03: Yeah, it's fine. It works.
Moderator: Earlier you mentioned losing a batch and checking repeatedly.
P03: Well, yeah. I suppose it doesn't work well. I've just stopped expecting it to.
